Heel,Ⓒs.ⒹpArzRi m. f., pAdatalaM-mUlaM; ‘to be at oneʼs h(eel)s’ pArzRiM grah 9 U, anusf, padaM anu-gam 1 P; ‘I shall be close upon your h(eel)s’ ahamanupadamAgata eva (S. 3) ‘to take to or show h(eel)s’ palAy 1 A, apakram 1 U, 4 P; ‘betake to h(eel)s’ jaMGAbalamava-laMb 1 A; ‘h(eel)s over head’ avAk-Siras a.; UrDvapAda a.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹekapArSve pat 1 P or parivft 1 A or pra-laMb 1 A.

Hell,Ⓒs.ⒹnarakaH, nirayaH, nArakaH, durgati f.
Ⓑ
 2 pAtAlaM, rasAtalaM, aDolokaH, aDoBuvanaM; ‘h(ell)-tortures’ kAraRA, yAtanA, tIvravedanA; ‘river of h(ell)’ vEtaraRI.
Ⓝ[Hell]ish,Ⓒa.ⒹnAraka (kI f.), narakIya, nArakIya (yI f.), naraka-sTa.
Ⓑ
 2 Cruel, q. v.
Ⓑ
 3 atiniMdya, duzwatama.

Helm,Ⓒs.ⒹkarRaH, kenipAtaH-takaH, aritraM.
Ⓑ
 2 Helmet, q. v.; ‘placed at the h(elm) of (royal) affairs’ rAjyaDurAyAM sTApita.
ⓃHelmsman,Ⓒs.ⒹkarRaDAraH, nAvikaH.

Help,Ⓒs.ⒹsAhAyyaM, upakAraH, upakftaM-kfti f., sAhityaM, anugrahaH, AnukUlyaM.
Ⓑ
 2 gati f., A-SrayaH, SaraRaM; ‘help! help!’ paritrAyaDvaM, paritrAyaDvaM.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹsAhAyyaM kf 8 U, sahAyaH BU, anugrah 9 P, upakf (gen.); na hi dIpO parasparasyopakurutaH (S. B. 420); tAnya-pi tattvajYAnAyopakurvaMti (S. B. 447) ‘h(elp) a right understanding’.
Ⓑ
 2 saMvfD c., pravft c., puraskf, udyuj 10; ‘h(elp)ed him on his legs’ utTAtuM tasya sAhAyyaM cakAra; ‘God h(elp)s those who h(elp) themselves’ dEvamudya-mAyattaM, vinA puruzakAreRa dEvaM na siDyati; dEvaM puruzakAreRa sADyasidDinibaMDanaM; na svayaM dEvamAdatte puruzArTamapekzate (S. R. 104); ‘canʼt h(elp)’ kA gatiH, kimanyacCaraRaM; ‘to h(elp) himself to a mouthful’ grAsagrahaRena AtmAnaM tarpayituM; ‘a h(elp)ing hand’ hastAvalaMbaH-banaM; dEvenetTaM dattahastAvalaMbe prAraMBe (Rat. 1); ‘he could not h(elp) laughing’ hAsaM nigrahItuM na SaSAka; ‘I cannot h(elp) going’ mayAvaSyaM gaMtavyaM; ‘to h(elp) at table’ pariviz 10.
Ⓝ[Help]er,Ⓒs.ⒹupakArakaH, upakartf m., sahAyaH.
Ⓝ[Help]ful,Ⓒa.Ⓓupayegin, sahAya, upa-kAraka, sAhAyyakArin.
Ⓝ[Help]less,Ⓒa.ⒹanATa, nirASraya, agatika, aSaraRa, gatihIna, nirava-laMba, asahAya.
Ⓑ
 2 apratikArya, aparihArya, apra-tiviDeya, nirupAya; ‘we are simply h(elpless) in that matter’ tasminvizaye asmAka-manyA gatireva nAsti.
ⓃHelpmate,Ⓒs.Ⓓsaha-DarmiRI.
Ⓑ
 2 sahAyaH, sahakArin m.
